👵 Labour's own MPs are warning that Burnham's plan to weaken the triple lock could be as unpopular as the winter fuel cut.

From 2030 the plan is pensions rising by inflation or 2.5% — not automatically with earnings. 1.9 million pensioners already live in poverty.

Pensioners paid in all their lives. They should not be the first place Labour looks for money. 💷
